_note: M7-P9. Play-time limit (a grown-up setting). Default off. Wording: no guilt, no pressure, no countdowns shown to the child.
title: Play-time limit
help: When time is up, your child finishes the room they're in. Then the game says well done and goes back to the dojo. Nothing they found is lost.
wrapUpLine: Nice work! Let's finish this room, then rest.
restLines: Everything you found is safe in your dojo.
